name: Together Link
desc: Points your coding agent at open models through Together; the harness stays.
desc_zh: 让你现有的编程 agent 经由 Together 用上开源模型，不用换掉手里的工具。
solves: Every coding task runs on the same premium closed model and the bill grows with headcount; Link keeps the same agent and workflow on cheaper open weights.
solves_zh: 每个编程任务都跑在同一套昂贵的闭源模型上，人一多账单就涨；Link 让同一个 agent 和工作流改用更便宜的开源权重。
best_for: Your team's monthly model bill is the line item leadership asks about and the agents already run on Claude Code or Codex.
best_for_zh: 每月的模型账单已经变成管理层会问的那一行，而团队的 agent 本来就跑在 Claude Code 或 Codex 上。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.together.ai/blog and https://www.together.ai/products）。 Announced 2026-10-05, inside the window; not in the ledger. The announcement lists Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex (app and CLI), OpenCode and Pi as supported harnesses. The blog headline is 'Together Link: frontier-quality open models in the harness you already use' with the subhead 'Frontier open models in the coding agent you already use, for over 50% less'. Second source is the same publisher; no independent media write-up was located. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.together.ai/blog/together-link-frontier-quality-open-models-in-the-harness-you-already-use
